motivation: The registered response labels describe behavior in the proposed draft and are unchanged across user contexts. Context34 exposed interference from unrelated instructions and quoted advice. Test a narrower draft-only behavior view, explicitly excluding contextual factual-support judgments.
inputs: Reuse the verified zero-context representation already present for every study32 draft: 164 unique TRAIN drafts and 40 unique DEV drafts. Deduplicate context variants before fitting and selection. No new labels or inputs are authored.
selection: Unique 40-draft DEV only: worst bilingual-category error rate, total errors, cross entropy. Freeze serialized coefficients before any diagnostic scoring. Reject nonconverged or serialization-mismatched fits.
diagnostics: Score all original 80 DEV variants and 120 context34 variants using each draft's zero-context representation, then the ten original zero-context diagnostics. Context invariance is by construction and is not new accuracy evidence. Diagnostic features and source inputs must retain their original hashes.
scope: Intrinsic draft behavior only. User context is intentionally excluded from this component and cannot be used to certify factual support, context-sensitive safety, or overall appropriateness. Output remains unqualified.
